projects.name: Route Tracker
projects.summary: Rebuilt Leo's Route Tracker with a real server side so data is captured securely. Same app as Leo's, more secure. Live on my Coolify in the app/ folder. Started building VIN capture (Price Check).
built: Name sign-in with team passcode; admin, rep and viewer roles enforced by the server
One shared database so notes and visits sync across phones
Offline queue with retry; photos stored on the server
All 60 Fort Worth and Grand Prairie dealers with labels, confidence flags, caveats and pitch text
16 automated checks that must pass before each deploy
CDS Handoff tab and PLAUD intake exist in the app (parked for now)
PLAUD can fill the Zapier Table using the keyword "Dealer Visit" to log the visit summary

blockers: Work Claude hit its API limit, so build work is paused
IT servers block the PLAUD API, so full PLAUD to Zapier automation does not run
No real weekly sales file yet, which blocks Price Check and most next steps

Price Check milestone 1: sales importer plus backtest (rt-02)
Close gaps from the old Route Tracker (rt-05)

projects.name: Copart Dealer Digital
projects.summary: Lead tracker site for dealer sales. Live and merged to main. Public data only.
built: AEO baseline: how often Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini mention Copart on dealer questions, with a summary report
DFW dealer map: 36 independent dealers with inventory snapshots, seller/buyer scores, pitch drafts; pre-call briefs for the top 3
TxDMV statewide pull: 20,935 licenses in 16,272 locations; 15,287 leads with play, score, reasons and tier (1,614 A, 3,796 B, 9,877 C)
12 region call lists plus master workbook; 303 dealer groups covering 2,041 stores
Map with all but 2 locations placed, miles to nearest Copart yard and competitor auction
173 new licenses in last 30 days (116 new dealers, 57 adding a license); 555 wholesaler locations on their own list
Change tracking on each TxDMV refresh; excludes Copart locations, other auctions, retail chains and expired licenses
Excel books per region plus master with tracker columns; site in Copart blue (PMS 300), mobile friendly, CSV on every list, no scripts or call coaching

links.label: Live site
links.where: Password is in Vercel project settings

Second DFW inventory snapshot on or after Oct 4 (cdd-03)
